entries.source: PANGERL, Stift Goldenkron (=FRA II/37, Wien 1872), S. 65, Nr. 28, 1317 II 27
entries.german: Wernher, Racko und Pribyk von Wityeuycz (Witějitz) bekennen, von dem Abte Theodorich und dem Convente zu Goldenkron das Dorf Freudtal (Frauenthal) nebst dem am Goldbach gelegenen Walde Strobole nur zu lebenslänglicher Nutzniessung empfangen zu haben.
entries.english: Wernher, Racko, and Pribyk of Wityeuycz (Witějitz) acknowledge having received from Abbot Theodorich and the convent of Goldenkron the village of Freudtal (Frauenthal) together with the forest of Strobole located on the Goldbach river solely as a life estate.
